details: The pointwise-majority (halving) learner is one particular equivalence-query strategy.
proof: The halving/majority procedure is one particular equivalence-query learner. Its query count is therefore at least the optimal equivalence-query complexity, which equals Littlestone dimension.
witness_verification: For the t-fold product C_maj^t with $t\ge1$, majority-query complexity is $3t$ whereas Littlestone dimension (and unrestricted equivalence-query complexity) is $2t$, by the database-owned endpoint proofs. This is a strict witness with ratio exactly $3/2$. Its growing additive gap does not refute a reverse affine bound; the former unbounded-strength classification was incorrect.
name: Majority Complexity / Littlestone Dimension
